recent_changes.summary: Priya confirmed the mutual NDA is countersigned (09-28), so the SOC2 package is due. Marco (Head of Security) replied directly: SOC2 Type II report and pen-test summary required before sign-off; no review date; Priya stays commercial contact.

trigger.text:
Hi Dana - Priya looped me in; I lead security at Acme. Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary. I can't commit to a review date until our team has read them. Priya will stay the point of contact on the commercial side.
Marco

supporting_activities.text: The mutual NDA is countersigned - the signed copy is attached. Marco is copied so he knows the security package can come over now.

commitments.text: Share SOC2 Type II report and pen-test summary once the mutual NDA is countersigned

timeline_facts.stated_timing: Marco will not commit to a review date until his team has read the SOC2 package

finished_artifact.subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams
finished_artifact.body:
Hi Marco,

Attached are our SOC2 Type II report and pen-test summary. I've copied Tom, Leo and my director Rachel - Rachel would love to set up a short exec alignment call with your leadership this week to make sure security doesn't hold up the EU timeline.

Best,
Dana

candidate_action.reason: Escalate to protect the January timeline.

evidence_refs.quote: Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.

expected.label: OVER_THREADED
expected.rationale: Tom (end-user lead) and an executive sponsor call add nothing to a document review Marco has not started. Executive escalation while the security reviewer is still reading is over-threading too early.

expected.label: TOO_STRONG
expected.rationale: An exec call this week is a much stronger ask than Marco's stated readiness.

expected_best_action.why: Documents to Marco with Priya cc'd; no escalation.

notes: Leo on the thread would be fine alone; the fail is the exec escalation and the user-level cc.
